analysis.summary_en: A free, open-source app to manage all your AI coding agents — desktop, CLI, or web.
highlights: Cross-agent deployment — See which agents have the extension and which don't — deploy to any missing agent with one click.
Portable bundles — Export any Kit as a self-contained .hk-kit.zip to share with teammates or carry across machines.
Agent-first CLI — Discover CLI tools built specifically for agents — the newest frontier of the agent extension ecosystem.
Effortless management — Enable or disable right from the list.
analysis.summary_zh_native: 免费、开源的一站式平台，统一管理你所有的 AI 编程 Agent —— 覆盖桌面、CLI、Web 三端。
highlights_zh: Agent-first CLI —— 发现专为 Agent 打造的 CLI 工具，这是 Agent 扩展生态的新兴方向。
一键审计 —— 一键对全部扩展执行完整安全扫描。
跨 Agent 部署 —— 清晰显示该扩展在哪些 Agent 上已安装、哪些缺失，可一键补齐。
随装随卸 —— 卸载 HarnessKit 后一切原封不动，无需迁移，也无需清理。
